WRANGLER GIVES YOU MULTIPLE WAYS TO BECOME ONE WITH
THE UNIVERSE. THREE UNIQUE TOP STYLES ALL LEAVE YOU OPEN
TO EXPERIENCE THE KIND OF OPEN-AIR FREEDOM THAT ONLY
WRANGLER CAN DELIVER. SO DECIDE HOW YOU WANT TO GET
YOUR TOP ON, THEN GET READY TO TAKE IT RIGHT OFF.
SUNRIDER® SOFT TOP
Standard on all Wrangler models, with an improved
design and easy-to-use zipperless closure. Its simple
operation allows the top to glide open with the help of
spring-loaded support bars. Crafted from heavy-duty,
waterproof cloth material and available in Black or Tan.
FREEDOM TOP® MODULAR HARDTOP
This three-piece hardtop is light and easy to remove.1 For a full
open-air experience, you can remove1 all three sections or let in
the sun by just removing1 the two front panels. Available in Black
on all trim levels or body-color on Sahara® and Rubicon® models.
SKY ONE-TOUCHTM POWER TOP
The first-ever power top on a Wrangler model gives
stargazers a cosmic-sized view. Open up even more
with the easy-to-remove1 rear glass
quarter panels. Available on Sahara and
Rubicon Wrangler Unlimited models.
FOLD-DOWN WINDSHIELD1 AND REMOVABLE1 DOORS
Remove1 just four windshield bolts to quickly fold down the windshield,
securing it with available straps. Side doors are made of lightweight
aluminum and are easy to remove1 with included tool.
